response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), t AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_records, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Players with a NULL birth_country form their own group, counted as a country in the overall average and in the share total. Matched records are kept even when the country is missing.
The share is each country's count divided by the total of all matched records, including the NULL-country group. The average count is the plain mean of per-country counts, not weighted.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude players whose birth_country is NULL, so only real countries are counted, in the average and in the share total.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), t AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_records, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
